title: Your data
body: Download a copy of everything MoneyFlow stores about you, or permanently delete your account.
deleteWarning: This deletes your profile, transactions, budgets, goals, Coach chats and payment history straight away. It can't be undone, and any remaining MoneyFlow Pro time is lost. Download your data first if you want a copy.
deletedNotice: Your MoneyFlow account and all its data have been deleted.
